audit.whatIsWrong: Marked EVEN at 6/10 on a 37.14% win rate over 35 games, while the prose says 'Singed wins the opening', 'you cannot out-tempo a drain-tank', 'this is where Singed fully takes over' and 'Accept it'.
audit.why: Nothing on the page argues for even. The kit agrees: Mega Adhesive grounds Galio's only gap-closer, and Singed's escape pattern beats a champion with one short dash and one point-blank taunt.
audit.corrected: diffRating and carryRating to 8/10 with the difficulty, carry, late and final-rating lines following. 'diff' (EVEN, 4 chars) and 'tone' cannot be changed inside the length band — flagged.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike treats Singed's ultimate as irrelevant; Insanity Potion is never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot: 'Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.' 100s cooldown. That is a direct counter to the Second Wind the rune page recommends and to every heal in Galio's build — while his R is up, the sustain you planned around is halved.
audit.corrected: Insanity Potion named at 6, in phases[4], in the itemization line and in loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes Fling to the W slot in five places ('his W fling', 'if he steps to fling', 'his W flings you back into it', 'Fling you with W'), and never once mentions what W actually is — Mega Adhesive, which GROUNDS.
audit.why: Riot slots: W = Mega Adhesive, 'Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it', 17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range. E = Fling, 'Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted', 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, 125 range. Grounding is the single decisive interaction of this matchup and it was absent: grounded, Justice Punch does not cast, so Galio's only gap-closer and only escape are both switched off by a 1000-range skillshot on a 17-second cooldown. The W-into-E root is his kill combo. Also the passive is Noxious Slipstream — a speed burst when he passes a champion, not standing move speed.
audit.corrected: W is Mega Adhesive (slow + ground), E is Fling (knockup, roots if you land in the glue), P is Noxious Slipstream. Never commit Justice Punch from inside the glue.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns says 'Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then E-stun.' Wrong ability, no numbers, and Justice Punch is a knockup rather than a stun.
audit.why: The matchup-defining cooldown is Mega Adhesive at 17/16/15/14/13s, because that is the one that turns your 11/10/9/8/7s Justice Punch off. Fling is 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range — he has to be on top of you.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt around Mega Adhesive with Fling's real numbers underneath.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math'.
audit.why: Nothing in Singed's kit heals. The anti-heal in this matchup runs the other way — Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on his Poison Trail and applies it to you.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line inverted to warn about his ult instead of selling an Oblivion Orb.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0] and breakdown.early both say 'your passive shield already blanks his chip'.
audit.why: Galio's passive is Colossal Smash, 'Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area'. There is no passive shield, so the reassurance is false and it invites the player to stand in poison.
audit.corrected: Both lines now say the passive is offence.

edits.before: Singed wins the opening. He doesn't burst, so Shield of Durand's magic reduction has nothing to soak even though his poison is magic damage -- the problem is he never needs to win a trade. His passive move speed plus W fling let him run you down rather than fight on your terms. At Level 1 you have only Q and no engage, so just last-hit at the tip of Winds of War and never walk into fling range near the poison trail. Your single real window is Level 3 once E and W are both up: if he steps to fling, dash E through him to knock him up, release W to taunt, then dump Q on the pinned target. But one trade rarely sticks -- his poison-and-run sustains it straight back.
edits.after: Singed wins the opening. He doesn't burst, so Shield of Durand's magic reduction has little to soak even though the poison is magic — the problem is he never needs to win a trade. Noxious Slipstream gives him a speed burst every time he passes a champion, and Mega Adhesive (W, 1000 range) slows AND grounds, which is the real reason this lane hurts: grounded, your Justice Punch does not cast at all. At Level 1 you have only Q and no engage, so last-hit at the tip of Winds of War and never stand in the trail. Your one window is Level 3: if he steps up to Fling (E), dash through him to knock him up, release W to taunt, then dump Q on the pinned target.

edits.before: You cannot out-tempo a drain-tank in a straight 1v1, so stop trying to win lane and start using your kit's real job. Level 6 is your one swing: Hero's Entrance does nothing to a Singed who will just proxy and farm, so flag a winnable lane and drop the global taunt there instead of feeding him kills mid. Never chase a fleeing Singed into his trail -- his W flings you back into it, and his move speed means your E dash and lone taunt can't pin a champion built specifically to never be caught by single CC.
edits.after: You cannot out-tempo a drain-tank in a straight 1v1, so stop trying to win lane. Level 6 is your one swing and it isn't here: Hero's Entrance does nothing to a Singed who will just proxy and farm, so flag a winnable lane instead. Respect his ult too — Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so Second Wind and every heal you bought stop working while it is up. Never chase him into the trail: Fling puts you behind him, and if you land in Mega Adhesive you are rooted.

edits.before: This is where Singed fully takes over. Once he has Rylai's and Liandry's, his self-slow, sustain, and move speed make him essentially uncatchable with your one source of hard CC -- your W-taunt and R-taunt are single windows he just runs out of. He proxies your waves, perma-splits, and forces your team to send two for one. Your damage and tankiness plateau while his scaling and sidelane pressure climb. Accept it: your only late value is map presence via Hero's Entrance and peeling for your carries in a 5v5 -- never the 1v1.
edits.after: This is where Singed fully takes over. Once he has Rylai's and Liandry's, his self-slow, sustain and speed make him uncatchable with your one source of hard CC — and Mega Adhesive grounds Justice Punch out of the chase entirely. He proxies your waves, perma-splits, and forces your team to send two for one. Your damage and tankiness plateau while his scaling and sidelane pressure climb. Accept it: your late value is map presence via Hero's Entrance and peeling for your carries in a 5v5, never the 1v1.

notes: This page had Singed's W and E swapped in five separate strings — every mention of 'Fling' pointed at the W slot, and Mega Adhesive, the ability that actually decides the matchup, appeared nowhere. Mega Adhesive grounds, and grounding switches Justice Punch off completely, which means Galio's only gap-closer and only escape are both denied by one 1000-range skillshot on a 17-second cooldown. That is the whole lane and the page never said it. Also inverted the anti-heal advice: the page sold an Oblivion Orb against a champion with no heal in his kit, when the actual Grievous Wounds in this matchup comes from Insanity Potion and lands on the Galio player. UNVERIFIED and left alone: whether Galio can pre-buffer or Flash out of a grounded state, and whether Fling's knockup can interrupt a Shield of Durand charge — the kit's needsResearch is empty, which means unknown. full.diff still reads EVEN on a 37% matchup and cannot be changed inside the length band.
